bodies.body:
Array-based layout areas replace space-separated strings throughout the schema, engine, examples, docs and skills. Defaults strengthen list text, keep compact metrics and quotes together, align numeric tables and place timeline labels beside their markers. Authored region pins and overrides remain intact.

The maintained native suite now covers 55 cases, with installed-package identities, bounded Windows actions and sealed geometry, list-edit and optional font-descriptor comparisons. Actual Windows metrics lifecycle/geometry passed for 13 shapes; final native list edits and font/visual acceptance remain open.

Validation: the frozen core runtime passed canonical package/CLI/root checks. The shared hosted timeline failure was an obsolete positive fixture: its narrow portrait column cannot preserve whole words at the required 24-pixel floor. The corrected positive fixture passes all 16 installed workflows; the original allocation remains two strict negative cases. Missing/ancestor installed consumers are rejected before browser execution. Independent review and mapped checks pass; engine behavior, content, font floors and baselines are unchanged by that correction.

The next breaking train targets 0.20.0. Core and CLI optional engine contracts and installation hints now require ^0.20.0. Reviewed source and integrated checks pass, including 2,328 core tests, 199 CLI tests and packed consumer/browser qualification. Current source versions remain 0.19 until genuine release preparation; staged qualification does not establish registry or native acceptance.

Integration order: after exact coordinated hosted/platform and review gates pass, merge engine source through the canonical merge gates. Then qualify Gallery 3 against actual merged core/renderer pins, publish and verify Gallery 3, adopt genuine registry dependencies, and complete the official ecosystem roll. Native list-edit, font and visual acceptance remain pending and must meet their applicable engine acceptance/release gates; source integration and the independent Gallery lane do not close them. No site deployment is included.

Render explicit array-area layouts and the coordinated typography, timeline and neutral structural defaults consistently with core. Bar, column and area magnitude axes include zero; authored alignment and colors remain respected.

Validation: all 119 package tests and the strict 807-example/495-template golden corpora pass, alongside remaining font and whitespace browser contracts. A test-only macOS fix canonicalizes the disposable font directory before comparing exact package paths; all corruption controls remain intact, and all 59 runtime files are byte-identical to the prior candidate. Focused checks and independent review pass.

Export the coordinated array-area layouts and editorial defaults to PowerPoint, including neutral structural rules, aligned numeric cells, compact metric/quote positioning and timelines. Native magnitude axes include zero while authored overrides remain respected.

Unchanged imports recover authored rich-text style presence and adapted single-column chart source data only while provenance matches. Native list-description edits now retain source identity so the edited text style can be recovered. Repository-native test actions support bounded text-style edits and optional font-descriptor capture.

Validation: the list-identity runtime passed all 138 package test files with unchanged strict archive expectations. Bounded style-action controls passed six accepted and 23 rejected plans on Windows without Office. Optional descriptor capture passes local mocked controls and review; actual Windows capture and native list-edit acceptance remain pending. Earlier metrics lifecycle and 13-shape geometry observations do not establish full native fidelity.

The shared installed timeline workflow now passes all 16 editing/export cases with two strict overflow controls against this unchanged editor runtime. These results are source/candidate qualification, not published-package or native PowerPoint acceptance.
